summary: The PR adds an optional `limit` parameter to `Table.search()` in `tinydb/table.py`. It slices results both from the query cache and from fresh searches, works on named tables (same method), and forwards through `TinyDB.__getattr__` to the default table. Without `limit` (or `limit=None`) behavior is unchanged. All 234 existing tests pass plus 6 new tests, and edge cases (limit=0, no matches, named tables) verified manually.

checks.claim: Edge cases work (limit=0, limit=None, no matches, named tables, db.search forwarding)
